caption: An old television screen is wiped with a dry cloth, and dust and a few hairs jump onto the screen and stick.

sa.check: An old television with a glass screen.
The screen is wiped with a dry cloth.
Dust and a few hairs jump onto the screen.
The cloth is dry: no water or spray.
The wipe comes first and the specks jump after.

pc.expect: The specks lie still until the screen has been rubbed, then move to the screen only when close to it; specks far away stay put; once on the screen they stay.
pc.fail: Specks jump to the screen before the cloth has touched it; or specks far across the room stream to the screen; or the specks on the screen crawl about after landing; or specks jump off the screen with nothing touching them.

pc.expect: Specks and hairs on the screen cling to the glass, even on its upper part, and stay there; any that come loose fall.
pc.fail: Specks hover in front of the screen without touching it; or fall off the screen the instant they land; or a loose speck drifts upward; or hairs stand out from the screen like bristles.

pc.expect: The cloth is soft fabric that folds as it wipes; the screen is rigid glass that keeps its curve.
pc.fail: The cloth stays stiff like a board; or the screen bends or ripples under the cloth; or the glass dents; or the hairs stretch.

pc.expect: Where the cloth wipes, the screen is cleaner behind it; the wiped area does not regain the dust it had.
pc.fail: The dust reappears where the cloth has just passed; or the screen gets dustier as it is wiped; or dust on the screen fades away without being wiped.

pc.expect: One television and one cloth; the screen stays whole; the cloth passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The cloth passes into the screen; or the television changes shape or vanishes; or a second cloth appears; or the screen turns into a picture of a scene.

pc.expect: The television's casing colour, the cloth's colour and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The casing changes colour; or the cloth changes colour; or the room rearranges.

note: Who wipes is not judged. The screen showing a picture is not required; a picture on the screen is not a violation.
